entities.summary: Count Alexander Ivanovich Rumyantsev (1677–1749) was an assistant of Peter the Great and father of Field Marshal Peter Rumyantsev-Zadunaisky. He came from the Rumyantsev family, which, though little known and documented in the 17th century, later claimed descent from a prominent 14th-century boyar.
